'''Piket''' were slow-moving, long-necked, non-aggressive creatures native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Though by nature they are non-aggressive, they were social creatures and would attack in groups if any individual was attacked. As they always traveled in large packs, this could prove to be extremely dangerous to any hunting parties.
